name: general-execution-manifest-workflow-precheck
description: Execution manifest generation, validation, and recovery for workflow preflight checks. Covers required fields, generation timing, version control, and recovery strategies when manifest is missing. 面向工作流编排系统，提供执行清单（execution manifest）的生成规范、验证契约和缺失恢复策略，确保工作流预检阶段能正确验证任务配置、步骤定义和资源绑定信息，并在清单缺失时触发自动恢复或降级机制。
